channel.title: Machinery: Korean small and mid-cap filings
channel.description: New filings from Korean small and mid-cap companies in the machinery sector.

item.title: Intekplus: Intekplus signed a KRW 14.6bn contract to supply semiconductor and substrate inspection equipment to takewin International Ltd for China.
Robotis: ROBOTIS signed a KRW 3.98bn DYNAMIXEL-X supply contract with Pollen Robotics SAS of France, 10.22% of recent revenue.
Narae Nanotech: Narae Nanotech signed a KRW 6.49bn display manufacturing equipment supply contract with BOE Display Technology for delivery in China.
Woniltni: Woniltni signed a KRW 4.39bn contract with Hanwha Power to supply a heater-performance skid retrofit, 14.82% of recent revenue.
GigaVis: GigaVis signed a KRW 44.7bn contract to supply semiconductor substrate inspection and repair equipment to a Chinese substrate manufacturer.
